root_idea.summary: The root displays three major semantic orientations: allotting a portion, becoming clear and firmly established, and removal, loss, or scantiness.
root_idea.development: The reduplicated verb حَصْحَصَ specializes in truth or another concealed matter becoming distinct and manifest. Other Classical branches extend the ideas of cutting off and allotting to shares, hair loss, depletion, rapid movement, and related descriptions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The group is a Quran-attested Form I verb with an independently supported lexical sense.

senses.definition: To become clear, distinct, and manifest after concealment; of the truth, to emerge as established and distinguishable from falsehood.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic use in the construction الْآنَ حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ, describing truth becoming apparent after what concealed it has been exposed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shave or cut off hair; also to cut off a portion from something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used directly of hair and more generally of something from which a part is severed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be shaved or have the hair removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive use corresponding to the transitive removal of hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sever or cut a tie of relationship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression حَصُّوا بَيْنَهُمْ رَحِمًا and marked as figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consume, do away with, or destroy everything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a dearth or drought that removes or consumes what is present.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To nip, shrivel, or blast plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal and figurative use applied to hoarfrost or rime damaging vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become someone's portion or allotted share.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction حَصَّنِي مِنَ الْمَالِ كَذَا, where property comes to someone as his share.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To run vehemently and quickly; to go or journey quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to rapid movement, running, or pace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide something with another person, each taking or allotting a portion for himself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III construction describing shared allocation of an object or property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone, or a group, a portion, lot, or share.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be food, drink, property, or another divisible resource.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide property among themselves in portions or shares.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction in which each participant takes his allotment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For hair, plumage, foliage, or fur to be removed, fall off, or become scattered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe hair falling away gradually, a beard becoming short, a tail being cut off, or feathers, foliage, or fur being stripped away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The walking of a shackled person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun describing movement while restrained by shackles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive, labor, exert oneself, or take extraordinary pains in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of strenuous effort exceeding the usual bounds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a camel to fix or steady its knees in order to rise with a load, or to lie down on its breast with folded legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a camel's movement and posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion, lot, or share of a whole, including a share of food, drink, land, or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes both a physical portion and an allotted share; its plural is حِصَصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Paucity or scantiness of the hair of the head or of a horse's fetlock; also shortness of the beard from hair breaking off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe a condition in which hair does not grow long, including after prolonged illness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mange or scab causing hair to fall off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The condition is named for the resulting loss of hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehemence or quickness of running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to an ass; descriptions may include erecting the ears, wagging the tail, and running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An audible emission of wind from the anus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported alternative interpretation of the term in a traditional expression; the same source prefers the interpretation relating it to rapid running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hair that has been shaven off; also a noun for such shaven hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied specifically to hair removed by shaving.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What is collected from shaving or plucking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term refers to the material removed by shaving or plucking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hair or fur of the ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some authorities extend the term to hair or fur generally, though the ear-specific use is reported as the more established one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hair above the part of a horse next to the hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained by the scantiness of that hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A laborious, swift journey or pace, especially a night journey to water without flagging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The journey may also be characterized as long or far-extending; the term is used in the expressions قَرَبٌ حَصْحَاصٌ and سَيْرٌ حَصْحَاصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease that causes hair to fall off gradually and become scattered, or removes it entirely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a disease characterized by loss of hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A relationship that has been severed or deprived of its due affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative active-participle form used of a tie of kinship that has been cut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having little or no hair, or having hair that has been rubbed, shaven, or fallen off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the head, beard, breast, tail, neck, horse fetlock, camel fur, or a bird's wing plumage, as specified by the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having no visible marks, streaks, or grain, said of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unlucky, unpropitious, or lacking good fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or woman and marked as figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The slave and the ass, in a conventional expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is explained through the two animals' declining value as they age.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who cuts or severs a tie of relationship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival use applied to someone who breaks kinship ties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sterile or drought-stricken year with little or no herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing a year lacking productive vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intensely cold day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term describes a clear, cloudless day whose severe cold does not abate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clear wind without dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival use applied to wind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Going or traveling through the land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun usage recorded as a branch of the reduplicated form, distinct from the Quranic sense of becoming manifest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for الوَرْس.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as an anomalous lexical item outside the principal semantic branches.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Synonymic cross-reference without independent lexical content.
Dividing a thing with another person.
Giving portions to a person or group.
Hair, plumage, foliage, or fur becoming removed.
Camel fixing its knees or lying down.
Quran-attested emergence of truth into clarity.
Mange or scab causing hair loss.
Rapid running and an alternative wind-emission interpretation.
Material collected by shaving or plucking.
Ear hair or fur, with a reported general extension.
A relationship that has been severed.
Little or absent hair and sparse plumage.

cautions: The Quranic sense is securely located at 12:51:21. Lane records several closely related nuances for the phrase, including becoming established, distinct, or manifest after concealment; these are presented as one subsuming sense rather than separate translations.
